name: Alessandro Benedetto
summary: Researcher in cognitive neuroscience and psychobiology at the University of Florence. His work focuses on human perceptual systems, sensorimotor integration, visual neuroscience and neural dynamics.
research: His research focuses on human perceptual systems and sensorimotor integration, combining psychophysics, EEG, fMRI, eye-movement recordings, computational modelling and pupillometry.

teaching.text: Teaching information is maintained on the official University of Florence profile and course catalogue.

cv: 2023–present: Fixed-term researcher at the University of Florence.
2022: Post-doc associate, Center for Visual Science, University of Rochester.
2017: PhD and Doctor Europaeus in Neuroscience, University of Florence.
2013: Master’s degree in Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience, Vita-Salute San Raffaele University.
topics: Current themes include visuomotor communication, neural oscillations, perceptual history and serial dependence, predictive modulation of perception, and the coupling between action and sensory processing.
